complete_relation_gluing.arbitrary_relation_coverage: For the same literal frame, J(R,S,T) is the union of J({p},S,T) over all original ordered p in R. Its root projection is U minus the intersection of set(p), unary singleton forbiddens and the spoke colour.
complete_relation_gluing.scope: Complete ordered relation algebra; abstract relations are not disk realizations.
